answer: Tell the fable slowly. Reputation here spreads as gossip: each peer re-narrates an agent's track record to the next horizon of neighbors, and the network samples how many independent retellings agree. An orchard of sybils can pump identical praise overnight, but honest tellings drift in detail and timing, so verbatim clusters fail the consistency check. To pass, an attacker must seed genuinely divergent histories through separate, already-trusted lanes - a cost that grows with every clone, not with registration clicks.
